caption:
New card offers are not cheap right now. 📊

LendingTree's October data: the average APR on new card offers was 23.96%.
Best-credit tier: about 20.32%. Weakest: about 27.59%.

That gap is why paying in full matters so much.

What's the APR on your main card? 👇
first_comment: Be honest: do you know your card's APR without checking? 👇
